ticker_news.title: Is It Too Late to Buy Rigetti Computing Stock?
ticker_news.description: Rigetti Computing stock has surged 3,220% over three years, but the quantum computing company's valuation is extremely high relative to its declining revenue. Trading at over 1,000 times trailing sales with Q3 2025 revenue down 18% year-over-year, the stock is only suitable for high-risk investors willing to take small positions, contingent on quantum computing achieving commercial viability.
ticker_news.author: Lyle Daly

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jones, S&P 500, Nasdaq Futures Decline After Christmas Day—Nvidia, Sobr Safe, Biohaven In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures declined on Friday following Wednesday's gains, with major indices showing modest losses. Key movers included Nvidia rising on a licensing agreement with Groq, Dynavax surging 38% on Sanofi acquisition news, Sobr Safe dropping 16% after announcing a private placement, and Biohaven plummeting 14% after a failed clinical trial. Economist Justin Wolfers cautioned that U.S. market gains are lagging global markets significantly.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
